name: Shashijit Infraprojects Limited
about: Shashijit Infraprojects Limited engages in the construction of residential, industrial, commercial, and institutional buildings in India. The company is involved in the civil project management business. It also constructs, designs, procures, builds, and develops industrial, commercial, residential, public utility building, driveways, powerhouse buildings, factories complexes, and infrastructure development projects. In addition, the company engages in the provision of turnkey industrial projects; engineering, procurement, and construction; project management consultancy; factory construction; infrastructure development; and leasing and hiring of construction equipment and machinery. Further, it is involved in development of educational infrastructure; and execution and supervision of industrial, residential, commercial, and public utility projects. Shashijit Infraprojects Limited was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Vapi, India.
